context: The horizontal axis is input size n, marked from 0 to 9. The vertical axis is running time, with labels 0, 5, 10, an ellipsis, and 1000000. The gap between 10 and 1000000 is compressed, so vertical distances do not use a uniform scale.
description: All three algorithms perform the same print operation. The table takes the print counts from the code in the text and the line colors and positions from the figure.

frames.explanation: The counts for A and C are independent of n. Both are O(1), although their running times differ greatly. B grows linearly with n and is O(n). Extrapolating the print counts, B meets C at n = 1000000, beyond the horizontal range shown.
frames.title: Algorithms A, B, and C: running time and growth

summary: The figure compares running time trends for algorithms A, B, and C, distinguishing elapsed time from its rate of growth.
